_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Finding the Light#000.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light
Finding the Light#000.dst: 新任務開始：光之領域 IV - 尋光

Finding the Light#001.src: That should have cracked open the foundation! You should check to see if you can reach the archive mentioned by the note card.
Finding the Light#001.dst: 那一下應該把地基裂開了！你該去看看能不能進到卡片上提到的檔案庫。

Finding the Light#002.src: The door down below should open, now that you've activated the mechanisms.
Finding the Light#002.dst: 機關都啟動了，下面那道門現在應該開了。

Finding the Light#003.src: Some of the few pages are ripped out. It seems to be describing an event occurring with the Guardian of the Forest until the first missing page.
Finding the Light#003.dst: 有幾頁被撕掉了。在第一頁缺頁之前，它似乎在描述森林守護者身上發生的事。

Finding the Light#004.src: The rest of the book is in perfect condition- Who could've done this if the archives were locked away? Did someone enter before you?
Finding the Light#004.dst: 書的其餘部分完好無缺——檔案庫既然是鎖起來的，這是誰做的？在你之前有人進來過嗎？

Finding the Light#005.src: ...so it returned, asleep and unwakeable. The light has spoken of a time when the Guardian shall grace us with its presence once more...
Finding the Light#005.dst: ……於是它回來了，沉睡不醒。光曾預示，終有一日守護者會再次現身於我們面前……

Finding the Light#006.src: ...but such a time is centuries off, and will require great effort. The spell included is vital to the process.
Finding the Light#006.dst: ……但那一日還在數百年之後，而且需要極大的努力。隨附的咒文是整個過程的關鍵。

Finding the Light#007.src: The light also warns- If the darkness should encroach and reach the Guardian's roots, it shall never wake... But it seems we will not have to worry of that.
Finding the Light#007.dst: 光也警告過——若黑暗進逼、觸及守護者的根，它便永遠不會醒來……但看來我們不必擔心那個。

Finding the Light#008.src: There's another loose page here, with more High Gavellian text on it. Lari should be able to translate this.
Finding the Light#008.dst: 這裡還有一張散頁，上面又是高階 Gavel 文。Lari 應該翻得出來。

Finding the Light#009.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thus far, it seems.
Finding the Light#009.dst: ……那就動手吧。目前看來，我在這裡就只是替你當個翻譯。

Finding the Light#011.src: The voice of the Light told you to pursue her. You shouldn't stop now, should you?
Finding the Light#011.dst: 光之聲要你去追她。你現在總不會停下來吧？

Finding the Light#012.src: The building looks climbable... You can probably eavesdrop on the conversation if you climb up the walls.
Finding the Light#012.dst: 這棟建築看起來爬得上去……沿著牆爬上去，也許就能偷聽到那段對話。

Finding the Light#014.src: You got the plant! You should return by the Guardian of the Forest to proceed.
Finding the Light#014.dst: 你拿到那株植物了！你該回到森林守護者那裡繼續。

Finding the Light#016.src: I DON'T CARE ANYMORE! STOP STEALING MY LIFE LIKE THIS!!!
Finding the Light#016.dst: 我不在乎了！別再這樣奪走我的人生！！！

Finding the Light#019.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS "ENOUGH!" TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#019.dst: ……啊啊啊啊！告訴我這怎麼算「夠了」！現在就告訴我！

Finding the Light#020.src: To do something "dark," you are about to say, and to that I say you have not.
Finding the Light#020.dst: 你正要說的是做了什麼「黑暗」的事——我要說的是，你並沒有。

Finding the Light#022.src: For a thousand years or more of your own thoughts, I understand that you are conflicted.
Finding the Light#022.dst: 獨自思索了千年甚至更久，我明白你心裡是矛盾的。

Finding the Light#023.src: However... You have, in that time, made a grave error. You have grown to realize an incorrect assumption.
Finding the Light#023.dst: 然而……在那段時間裡，你犯了一個嚴重的錯。你把一個錯誤的前提當成了真理。

Finding the Light#024.src: Dark and Light... They oppose. They clash. They create a cloying pox. But, allow me to ask.
Finding the Light#024.dst: 黑暗與光……彼此對立。彼此衝撞。生出一片令人窒息的瘡痍。但，容我問你。

Finding the Light#025.src: Is the axe evil for chopping the tree? Is the wood evil for resisting the metal?
Finding the Light#025.dst: 斧頭砍樹，斧頭就是惡的嗎？木頭抵抗鐵器，木頭就是惡的嗎？

Finding the Light#026.src: Are the flames evil for burning up the leaves? Is the water evil for dousing the fire?
Finding the Light#026.dst: 火燒了葉子，火就是惡的嗎？水澆熄了火，水就是惡的嗎？

Finding the Light#027.src: Is a victim evil for striking back against those that have struck them?
Finding the Light#027.dst: 受害者反擊傷害他的人，受害者就是惡的嗎？

Finding the Light#028.src: And most importantly... Are any of these things light, or dark?
Finding the Light#028.dst: 而最重要的是……這些東西，哪一樣是光，哪一樣是暗？

Finding the Light#030.src: I will not ask you to. You must understand that Orphion has no moral bearings- He simply needs action.
Finding the Light#030.dst: 我不會要求你那麼做。你必須明白，Orphion 沒有道德上的立場——他要的只是行動。

Finding the Light#031.src: I admit, such a thing is a conundrum. I agree that it is a tragedy to kill, in many instances.
Finding the Light#031.dst: 我承認，那確實是個難題。在許多情況下，殺戮的確是一場悲劇。

Finding the Light#032.src: Yet when such an action could save the lives of others, it becomes a conundrum with no answer. An impossible value to weigh.
Finding the Light#032.dst: 但當那樣的行動能救下其他人的性命，它就成了一道無解的難題。一個秤不出來的重量。

Finding the Light#033.src: Despite the circumstances, you have done the best you could. I cannot fault you for your thoughts and morals.
Finding the Light#033.dst: 在那樣的處境下，你已經盡了你所能。我無法苛責你的想法與良知。

Finding the Light#034.src: And so... As you are now proven, as I am awoken, the gateway to the Light shall reveal itself to you. Lari... You must prepare for your journey to the Realm of Light.
Finding the Light#034.dst: 所以……如今你已得到印證，我也已甦醒，通往光的門扉將為你顯現。Lari……你必須為前往光之領域做好準備。

Finding the Light#035.src: I do not blame you for it. By the time you have composed yourself, your ally will be ready. Understand that they are as necessary as you are.
Finding the Light#035.dst: 我不怪你。等你整理好自己，你的同伴就會準備妥當。要明白，他們和你同樣不可或缺。

Finding the Light#036.src: I must ask you to pay close attention. I shall present it simply- though the enormity of this cannot be understated.
Finding the Light#036.dst: 我得請你仔細聽。我會盡量講得簡單——儘管這件事的分量再怎麼說都不為過。

Finding the Light#038.src: This is our world, the world we stand in right now. The physical plane of existence.
Finding the Light#038.dst: 這是我們的世界，我們此刻所站的世界。存在的物質層面。

Finding the Light#039.src: Only a select few are aware that there is more of the world than this. Even the astronomers and those who view the enormity of the sky cannot understand.
Finding the Light#039.dst: 只有極少數人知道，世界不只如此。就連仰望蒼穹、見識過天空之浩瀚的天文學者也無法理解。

Finding the Light#040.src: For, you see, this realm, this plane- It is mirrored upon a second plane, as the embodiments of Realms clash.
Finding the Light#040.dst: 因為，你看，這個領域、這個層面——它被映照在第二個層面上，諸領域的化身在那裡彼此衝撞。

Finding the Light#041.src: This is the Plane of Influence, comprised of many realms. There are three you must know- But only one you must pay attention to.
Finding the Light#041.dst: 那是影響層，由許多領域構成。有三個是你必須知道的——但只有一個是你必須留意的。

Finding the Light#042.src: The Realms of Influence are connected to the physical plane, tied inexorably so to it. This is why even those gazing at the cosmos cannot grasp the enormity of it.
Finding the Light#042.dst: 諸影響領域與物質層相連，而且連得密不可分。這正是為什麼連凝望宇宙的人也掌握不了它的全貌。

Finding the Light#043.src: These realms are in a constant push and pull- Battles that could not be seen by those of this world, waged constantly.
Finding the Light#043.dst: 這些領域一直在推擠與拉扯——那是這個世界的人看不見、卻從未停過的戰爭。

Finding the Light#044.src: However, they can be felt. Wide-scale changes to the balance of one realm or another are reflected on the physical plane.
Finding the Light#044.dst: 但那是感覺得到的。任何一個領域的平衡出現大規模變動，都會反映在物質層上。

Finding the Light#045.src: The Realms of Influence are, themselves, reflections of a Beast- They themselves, a physical manifestation of their realm, as their realm is a manifestation of them.
Finding the Light#045.dst: 諸影響領域本身就是巨獸的倒影——牠們是自身領域的具現，正如那領域也是牠們的具現。

Finding the Light#046.src: So surely, you must know- As Gavel has decayed, it must mean that the Realm of Light is in peril, and thus that Orphion is, as well.
Finding the Light#046.dst: 所以你一定明白——既然 Gavel 已經衰敗，那就代表光之領域正陷入危機，而 Orphion 也是。

Finding the Light#047.src: The Light is infected- That abominable parasite has breached the Realm of Light, and sought Orphion to leech away his light.
Finding the Light#047.dst: 光被感染了——那頭可憎的寄生體已經侵入光之領域，尋到 Orphion，一點一點吸走他的光。

Finding the Light#048.src: And so, as the sun is forced to set, the land of Gavel grows dark. As the dark parasites spread and devour the minds of those here, so too is Orphion subject to this torture.
Finding the Light#048.dst: 於是，太陽被迫西沉，Gavel 的土地日漸昏暗。當黑暗的寄生體蔓延、吞食這裡眾人的心智，Orphion 也承受著同樣的折磨。

Finding the Light#049.src: Now, you must enter the Realm of Light, and aid Lari in purging the parasite, before its work is finished and Orphion's mind is consumed.
Finding the Light#049.dst: 現在，你必須進入光之領域，協助 Lari 清除那頭寄生體——趕在它完成它的工作、Orphion 的心智被吞噬之前。

Finding the Light#050.src: You must ready yourself before this, of course. To venture to another realm is a lofty task.
Finding the Light#050.dst: 當然，在那之前你必須先做好準備。前往另一個領域是件大事。

Finding the Light#051.src: I will bestow upon you two things that will surely aid you in this, however. First, I shall provide you the way to the Gateway to Light.
Finding the Light#051.dst: 不過我會賜你兩樣東西，那想必幫得上你。首先，我會為你指出通往光之門的路。

Finding the Light#052.src: Once you have reached it, I shall bestow upon you a personal blessing of mine, in the hopes that your path will become clear.
Finding the Light#052.dst: 等你抵達那裡，我會親自賜予你一份祝福，願你的前路因此清明。

Finding the Light#055.dst: 醒來！我們需要你的指引！
Finding the Light#055.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#056.src: ...ah. {u}. So you are needed here too, then?
Finding the Light#056.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#057.src: I am... TRYING... To awaken the Guardian of the Forest to receive its guidance, but it refuses to budge! Even the voice of Orphion provides no reaction.
Finding the Light#057.dst: 我正在……努力……喚醒森林守護者，想得到它的指引，可它就是不肯動！連 Orphion 的聲音都得不到半點回應。
Finding the Light#057.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#058.src: I beg once more of you, awaken! Us two... Us two seek your wisdom!
Finding the Light#058.dst: 我再求你一次，醒來吧！我們兩個……我們兩個都在尋求你的智慧！
Finding the Light#058.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#059.src: I present you Orphion's barest light- Please, respond!
Finding the Light#059.dst: 我獻上 Orphion 最微薄的一縷光——拜託，回應我！
Finding the Light#059.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#060.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can affect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#060.dst: 唔……看到了吧？什麼都沒發生。我已經不知道還能做什麼了。也許你能讓事情有點轉機，畢竟你以前做過那些事。
Finding the Light#060.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#061.src: My pulse, it is time. I shall shine my light upon the roots of the Guardian. You and she must learn now.
Finding the Light#061.dst: 我的脈動，時候到了。我將把我的光照在守護者的根上。你與她，都必須在此刻學會。

Finding the Light#062.src: Read the inscription at the bottom of the big tree.

Finding the Light#063.src: An inscription! That wasn't there before! It was... That was completely instant. How did you even...?
Finding the Light#063.dst: 一段銘文！剛才根本沒有這個東西！那是……那是瞬間出現的。你到底是怎麼……？
Finding the Light#063.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#064.src: But, still! I knew I could be useful, let me translate this for you! As a stranger to Gavel you wouldn't know High Gavellian...
Finding the Light#064.dst: 不過，總算有進展了！我就知道我幫得上忙，讓我替你翻譯！你是 Gavel 的外人，不可能懂高階 Gavel 語……
Finding the Light#064.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#065.src: It says... Secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in {p}.
Finding the Light#065.dst: 上面寫著……祕密藏在 {p} 最古老的圖書館裡。
Finding the Light#065.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#066.src: ...of course. A place that Elves aren't allowed, but humans are. {u}, you'll have to find this library on your own, it seems.
Finding the Light#066.dst: ……當然了。一個精靈不得進入、人類卻可以的地方。{u}，看來這座圖書館得由你自己去找了。
Finding the Light#066.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#067.src: Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Finding the Light#068.src: Find a way up to the church bell at the top of the church.
Finding the Light#068.dst: 想辦法爬到教堂頂端的鐘那裡。

Finding the Light#069.src: Explore the secret library and find a way to wake up the tree.
Finding the Light#069.dst: 探索祕密圖書館，找出喚醒那棵樹的方法。

Finding the Light#071.src: Do you reject the light of Orphion? Waken, please!
Finding the Light#071.dst: 你要拒絕 Orphion 的光嗎？醒來，拜託你！
Finding the Light#071.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#072.src: Urgh... {u}, please tell me you were able to make some progress. The Guardian still refuses... To... WAKE!
Finding the Light#072.dst: 唔……{u}，拜託告訴我你那邊有進展。守護者還是不肯……給我……醒過來！
Finding the Light#072.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#073.src: What is this? A spell scroll- Of the Waking Forest?! In {p}, of all places? Where it would have been... Impossible for me to go...
Finding the Light#073.dst: 這是什麼？一卷法術卷軸——喚醒森林的？！而且偏偏是在 {p}？那個我根本……根本進不去的地方……
Finding the Light#073.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#074.src: So I am Orphion's chosen, yet I would not have been able to do what was asked of me. That... No, I can't dwell on that, let me see the scroll.
Finding the Light#074.dst: 所以我是 Orphion 的受選者，卻連交代給我的事都做不到。那……不，我不能糾結在這上面，讓我看看卷軸。
Finding the Light#074.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#075.src: ...hm. It says, The seeker must rest these words upon those of the Guardian.
Finding the Light#075.dst: ……嗯。上面說：求道者須將此言安放於守護者之言上。
Finding the Light#075.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#076.src: I suppose that means you need to place it by the inscription. So yet another task that you must finish...
Finding the Light#076.dst: 我想意思是你得把它放在銘文旁邊。所以，又是一件得由你完成的事……
Finding the Light#076.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#077.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thusfar, it seems.
Finding the Light#077.dst: ……去吧。到目前為止，我在這裡好像也就只剩替你翻譯的用處了。
Finding the Light#077.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#078.src: Use the spell on the inscription under the tree.
Finding the Light#078.dst: 對樹下的銘文使用法術。

Finding the Light#079.src: Let me go ahead and read this, too. This will be tedious, I fear...
Finding the Light#079.dst: 這一段也讓我來讀吧。我想這會很費工夫……
Finding the Light#079.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#080.src: It says... Awakening the Guardian of the Forest requires more than just magic. The home of the elves will house the answers and revelations...?
Finding the Light#080.dst: 上面說……喚醒森林守護者，需要的不只是魔法。精靈的家園將藏有答案與啟示……？
Finding the Light#080.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#081.src: That... This is finally my time! I still have a hand in this!! Finally, I can do something more than just holding stasis here!
Finding the Light#081.dst: 那……這總算輪到我了！我在這件事上還有份量！！我終於可以做點什麼，而不是只在這裡撐著僵局！
Finding the Light#081.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#082.src: Listen, {u}. Achara... This is my time. I can finally help you more directly. I know the elders of {p}- They're sure to have answers!
Finding the Light#082.dst: 聽好，{u}。Achara……這是屬於我的時刻。我終於能更直接地幫上忙了。我認識 {p} 的長老們——他們一定有答案！
Finding the Light#082.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#083.src: You truly have been helpful, even through my own worries. I must thank you, but you can relax now! I will be the one this time!
Finding the Light#083.dst: 你真的幫了大忙，即使我心裡一直在彆扭。我該謝謝你，但你現在可以放鬆了！這一次換我來！
Finding the Light#083.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#084.src: You can continue doing...whatever else it is you need doing. I have seen you helping in various places- Concern yourself with those for now. I can handle this.
Finding the Light#084.dst: 你可以去忙……你其他該忙的事。我看過你在各地幫忙——先去顧那些吧。這裡我應付得來。
Finding the Light#084.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#085.src: Pursue her, my pulse. She must take dire action- Alone, her light shall illuminate nothing. You must provide her direction.
Finding the Light#085.dst: 追上她，我的脈動。她必須採取決絕的行動——僅憑她自己，她的光照不亮任何東西。你必須為她指出方向。

Finding the Light#086.src: Enter the portal Lari left behind
Finding the Light#086.dst: 進入 Lari 留下的傳送門。

Finding the Light#087.src: Go to the hut Lari entered.
Finding the Light#087.dst: 前往 Lari 進入的小屋。

Finding the Light#088.src: W-What? You- Why did you follow me? I can handle this! I can finally be useful again! Do you...not trust me?
Finding the Light#088.dst: 什——什麼？你——你為什麼要跟過來？這件事我應付得來！我終於又能派上用場了！你是……不信任我嗎？
Finding the Light#088.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#089.src: Please, just respect my wishes! If I need your help, I'll go find you- For now, just leave! You don't need to worry about this!
Finding the Light#089.dst: 拜託，就尊重我的意願一次！我需要你幫忙的話，我會去找你——現在，請你離開！這件事你不必操心！
Finding the Light#089.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#090.src: Find a way to sneak into the hut.

Finding the Light#091.src: ...if this human has truly done what you have said, then why do you spurn their aid? It is unlike you.
Finding the Light#091.dst: ……若這名人類真的做到了你所說的那些事，你又為何要推開他們的援手？這不像你。
Finding the Light#091.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#092.src: I know, I know. I just am in disbelief. They've been contacted by Orphion himself, allowed into the Taproot, they have a symbol of Orphion's blessing!!
Finding the Light#092.dst: 我知道，我知道。我只是不敢相信。Orphion 親自與他們接觸過，他們被允許進入 Taproot，他們身上帶著 Orphion 賜福的印記！！
Finding the Light#092.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#093.src: They just...walked up, after a thousand years of my putting my entire life into trying to save this province, and do everything I couldn't, in the span of weeks at most!
Finding the Light#093.dst: 他們就這樣……走了過來，而我把整整一千年的人生都投進去、只想救這個行省，他們卻在頂多幾週之內，把我做不到的事全做完了！
Finding the Light#093.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#094.src: Do you understand how infuriating this is? Can you comprehend such a thing, not having been in my position yourself?
Finding the Light#094.dst: 你明白這有多令人抓狂嗎？你自己沒站在我的位置上，能理解這種事嗎？
Finding the Light#094.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#095.src: No. I cannot understand. But I also cannot understand how you are not grateful for this aid.
Finding the Light#095.dst: 不。我無法理解。但我同樣無法理解，你為何不對這份援手心懷感激。
Finding the Light#095.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#096.src: I know I should be! It's all I've been able to think about. I should be ecstatic! The light will be saved, it should be everything I've dreamed of...
Finding the Light#096.dst: 我知道我應該感激！我腦子裡想的就只有這件事。我應該欣喜若狂才對！光將會得救，那本該是我夢寐以求的一切……
Finding the Light#096.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#097.src: But it makes me feel like a complete failure. Like everything I have done has been for naught, that I have somehow been doing everything wrong!
Finding the Light#097.dst: 可是這讓我覺得自己是個徹頭徹尾的失敗者。好像我做過的一切都白費了，好像我一路以來全都做錯了！
Finding the Light#097.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#098.src: I know I have made mistakes. Dullahan would still be... Still be himself, if I had taken faster action, but I can't have done nothing right. I can't accept that.
Finding the Light#098.dst: 我知道我犯過錯。要是我當初動作快一點，Dullahan 現在還會是……還會是他自己。但我不可能一件事都沒做對。我沒辦法接受那樣。
Finding the Light#098.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#099.src: This is my chance to prove I can still be useful- that Orphion choosing me wasn't a fluke! Please, the inscription said you would know where to go!
Finding the Light#099.dst: 這是我證明自己還有用的機會——證明 Orphion 選中我不是一場僥倖！拜託，銘文說您會知道該去哪裡！
Finding the Light#099.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#101.src: ...even after a millennium, there is so very much for us all to learn. Fine then.
Finding the Light#101.dst: ……即便過了一千年，我們要學的東西依然多得很。那好吧。
Finding the Light#101.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#102.src: But promise me to accept the aid you receive. This opportunity cannot be wasted, Lari.
Finding the Light#102.dst: 但你要答應我，接受你得到的援手。這個機會不容浪費，Lari。
Finding the Light#102.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#103.src: ...I have to do at least one thing right. I can't just keep up this holding pattern. I'll do whatever is necessary!
Finding the Light#103.dst: ……我至少得做對一件事。我不能再這樣原地打轉下去了。要做什麼我都做！
Finding the Light#103.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#104.src: You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
Finding the Light#104.dst: 那麼，你必須去尋找 Canned Abis 這種植物。它長在一處被巨大蕨葉遮蔽的洞窟裡。
Finding the Light#104.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#105.src: Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
Finding the Light#105.dst: 謝謝您。我終於能做我本該做的事了！這一次我不會讓任何東西攔住我！！
Finding the Light#105.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#106.src: ...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
Finding the Light#106.dst: ……人類，我看得見你。她沒看見，算你走運。過來說話。
Finding the Light#106.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#108.src: So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
Finding the Light#108.dst: 所以你就是 Orphion 新的受選者。這既令人意外，也不令人意外——人類的名聲很有意思。
Finding the Light#108.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#109.src: Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
Finding the Light#109.dst: 人們常說，人類什麼事都做得成，毫無限制——不論是完成不可能的任務，還是打破道德的戒律。
Finding the Light#109.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#110.src: In this instance, however, you've both to do. Orphion has commanded it, has he not? And so you must, and for that I apologize.
Finding the Light#110.dst: 不過在這件事上，這兩樣你都得做。Orphion 已經下了令，不是嗎？所以你非做不可，而為此我向你致歉。
Finding the Light#110.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#111.src: I have seen Lari's work- And she has done this land a priceless service. Alone, she has kept the Decay from creeping south, and thus the Guardian remains with us.
Finding the Light#111.dst: 我看過 Lari 的作為——她為這片土地立下了無價的功勞。是她一個人擋住了黯蝕南下，守護者才得以留在我們身邊。
Finding the Light#111.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#112.src: However, her own morals prevent the situation from progressing. She cannot kill- And the source must be exterminated for light to once again fill the land.
Finding the Light#112.dst: 然而，正是她自己的道德讓局面無法推進。她下不了殺手——而唯有根除源頭，光才能再度充滿這片土地。
Finding the Light#112.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#113.src: Orphion's circumstances are dire- And so you must come to understand something. He is above us, in terms of morals. Such concepts do not apply to him.
Finding the Light#113.dst: Orphion 的處境已經危急——所以有件事你必須明白。祂在道德的層次上高於我們。那些概念並不適用於祂。
Finding the Light#113.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#114.src: As the embodiment of Light itself, he has no sense of morals- Merely survival and stasis. What he asks of us, many will balk at.
Finding the Light#114.dst: 身為光本身的化身，祂沒有道德觀——只有存續與維持。祂要求我們做的事，許多人會退避三舍。
Finding the Light#114.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#115.src: It is a matter where morals must be set aside... And such a thing is one that Lari cannot abide by, for she has stubbornly clung to them for a thousand years.
Finding the Light#115.dst: 這是一件必須把道德擱在一旁的事……而那正是 Lari 無法接受的，因為她固執地守了那些東西一千年。
Finding the Light#115.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#116.src: To break them... I will admit, I believe there to be some other way to solve these problems, but the fact of the matter is there simply is no time left.
Finding the Light#116.dst: 要打破它們……我承認，我相信這些問題還有別的解法，但事實是，已經沒有時間了。
Finding the Light#116.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#117.src: She must use the extent of her powers, and while she retains her pacifism that will not happen. I must ask you to follow her, as Orphion would wish.
Finding the Light#117.dst: 她必須用盡她全部的力量，而只要她還抱著那份不殺的堅持，那就不會發生。我必須請你跟著她，一如 Orphion 所願。
Finding the Light#117.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#118.src: There is, unfortunately, no right to this. There is simply necessity- And there, you must push her to her limits. Seek the cave of the Canned Abis.
Finding the Light#118.dst: 很遺憾，這件事沒有所謂的對錯。只有不得不然——而在那裡，你必須把她逼到極限。去找 Canned Abis 的洞窟。
Finding the Light#118.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#119.src: It is north-east from here. The entrance is shaded by giant fern leaves. I only pray that this will be enough.
Finding the Light#119.dst: 從這裡往東北方。入口被巨大的蕨葉遮著。我只能祈禱這樣就夠了。
Finding the Light#119.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#120.src: Find the Canned Abis cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Finding the Light#120.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找到 Canned Abis 洞窟。

Finding the Light#121.src: Find the plant inside the cave.
Finding the Light#121.dst: 在洞窟裡找到那株植物。

Finding the Light#123.src: ...I can't believe this. What am I doing wrong? What is it? There has to be some reason, what IS it?!
Finding the Light#123.dst: ……我不敢相信。我到底做錯了什麼？是哪裡？一定有什麼原因，到底是什麼？！
Finding the Light#123.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#124.src: There's not another inscription...it's just the same words! What does it mean by ‘’dire actions?!‘’ I've done everything I can think of!
Finding the Light#124.dst: 根本沒有新的銘文……還是同樣那幾句話！「決絕的行動」到底是什麼意思？！我想得到的我全做了！
Finding the Light#124.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#125.src: Is- Is this not dire enough? Is poring over you and putting aside my role and pride to someone else not EXTREME enough?!
Finding the Light#125.dst: 這——這樣還不夠決絕嗎？把自己剖開來檢視、把我的位置和我的驕傲都讓給別人，這樣還不夠極端嗎？！
Finding the Light#125.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#126.src: .... I. I have to know. What did Orphion tell you, exactly? I can't stand not knowing any longer. Did he really replace me?
Finding the Light#126.dst: ……我。我必須知道。Orphion 到底跟你說了什麼？我再也受不了這樣蒙在鼓裡。他真的把我換掉了嗎？
Finding the Light#126.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#127.src: I can't think of any other reason why everything for me has just...stopped working. Did he? Please, tell me-
Finding the Light#127.dst: 我想不出還有什麼別的理由，能解釋為什麼我這邊的一切就這樣……全都不管用了。是嗎？拜託，告訴我——
Finding the Light#127.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#128.src: ...wait... You... You have Canned Abis on you!! Where did you get that?!
Finding the Light#128.dst: ……等等……你……你身上有 Canned Abis！！你從哪裡拿到的？！
Finding the Light#128.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#129.src: You... There's no way you would've known that unless you... YOU! You eavesdropped on me!!
Finding the Light#129.dst: 你……你不可能會知道那個，除非你——是你！你偷聽了我說話！！
Finding the Light#129.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#130.src: You FOLLOWED ME into the cave even after I asked not to! You... After everything I said!! After you heard all those private thoughts!
Finding the Light#130.dst: 我明明叫你別跟來，你還是跟進洞窟裡了！你……在我說了那些話之後！！在你聽完那些私密的心事之後！
Finding the Light#130.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#131.src: You STILL decided it was a good idea to come after me! What are you planning to accomplish like this?!
Finding the Light#131.dst: 你居然還覺得追上來是個好主意！你這樣到底想達成什麼？！
Finding the Light#131.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#132.src: What, are you thinking ‘’oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?‘’ IS THAT IT?!
Finding the Light#132.dst: 怎麼，你是在想「哦，跟著那個好笑的精靈女孩，看她一次又一次失敗吧」？！是這樣嗎？！
Finding the Light#132.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#133.src: You heard me then!! It's ALL out in the open! I can't succeed! You're there! You're doing everything I couldn't!
Finding the Light#133.dst: 那你都聽見了！！全都攤在陽光下了！我成不了事！你在那裡！我做不到的，你全都做到了！
Finding the Light#133.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#134.src: I'm NOT a failure! I'm not! I won't be! I refuse to be! You don't GET to watch me flounder and flail!!
Finding the Light#134.dst: 我不是失敗者！我不是！我不會是！我拒絕當那種東西！你沒資格站在那裡看我掙扎、看我出醜！！
Finding the Light#134.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#137.src: Wha- I... What just... What did I...?
Finding the Light#137.dst: 什——我……剛才怎麼……我做了什麼……？
Finding the Light#137.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#140.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS ‘’ENOUGH!‘’ TELL ME, NOW!
Finding the Light#140.dst: ……啊啊啊啊——！！告訴我這樣怎麼會「夠了」！現在就告訴我！
Finding the Light#140.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#141.src: I-I NEARLY KILLED THEM! I JUST BROKE AND DEFILED EVERYTHING I'VE EVER STOOD FOR!!
Finding the Light#141.dst: 我差一點就殺了他們！我親手粉碎、玷污了我這輩子所堅持的一切！！
Finding the Light#141.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#142.src: TELL ME!! HOW COULD THIS POSSIBLY BE THE ANSWER?! HOW COULD THIS BE WHAT NEEDED TO HAPPEN?!
Finding the Light#142.dst: 告訴我！！這怎麼可能會是答案？！這怎麼可能是非發生不可的事？！
Finding the Light#142.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#143.src: WHY WOULD I BE NEEDED TO... To...
Finding the Light#143.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#144.src: T-Trying to murder them because they did what I couldn't isn't dark? How can you possibly think that?!
Finding the Light#144.dst: 因為他們做到了我做不到的事，我就想殺了他們——這不算墮入黑暗嗎？你怎麼可能這樣想？！
Finding the Light#144.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#145.src: What kind of guardian are you, permissing this kind of violence? How is anything I just did alright?
Finding the Light#145.dst: 你算什麼守護者，居然容許這種暴行？我剛才做的事，哪一點是可以的？
Finding the Light#145.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#146.src: ...you. You can't possibly be saying that what I did was the right thing to do. I refuse to accept that.
Finding the Light#146.dst: ……你。你不可能是在說我剛才做的是對的。我拒絕接受這種說法。
Finding the Light#146.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#148.src: ...then... Shouldn't I feel... I don't know. Shouldn't I feel less restrained? Less afraid? More... More free?
Finding the Light#148.dst: ……那麼……我不是應該覺得……我不知道。我不是應該覺得比較不受束縛？比較不害怕？比較……比較自由嗎？
Finding the Light#148.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#149.src: If what I've done was what needed to happen, why do I feel like the scum of the earth? Why do I feel so terrible?!
Finding the Light#149.dst: 如果我做的正是非做不可的事，為什麼我覺得自己像地上的爛泥？為什麼我這麼難受？！
Finding the Light#149.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#150.src: ...I... I need time to process this. I... Do you understand how difficult this is to hear? To bear?
Finding the Light#150.dst: ……我……我需要時間消化這件事。我……你明白這有多難聽進去嗎？有多難承受嗎？
Finding the Light#150.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#151.src: My pulse, your light is brilliant... It has shone upon Lari, and soon her light will shine my way...
Finding the Light#151.dst: 我的脈動，你的光何其燦亮……它已照在 Lari 身上，不久之後，她的光也將照向我……

Finding the Light#152.src: Enter the roots, and witness the path to my realm. And then, prepare yourself. Muster your most blinding light...
Finding the Light#152.dst: 進入根中，見證通往我領域的道路。然後，做好準備。凝聚起你最耀眼的光……
